questions.unnecessary_complexity: No material removable subsystem; the modules match contract, reducer, epoch, state and planner owners.
questions.duplicate_truth: Append-only events remain authoritative and mutable Work Order state is checked only as a snapshot.
questions.implicit_owner: MAIN/HARNESS is explicit for the public control boundary.
questions.coupling_reduction: All three commands share one state builder and command-specific projection.
questions.sibling_surface_fix: Guard, predicate, epoch, provenance and output repairs cover Status, Plan and Resume together.
questions.removable_code: No material code can be removed without weakening a verified invariant.
questions.design_regression: Review freshness currently compares reviewed head with ledger current head; recording review evidence would falsely make it stale despite unchanged implementation surfaces.
questions.refactor_if_redesigned: Expose and compare an implementation-surface head separately from event ledger and branch heads.

required_refactor: Derive implementation_head_sha from the latest commit touching H0.0 implementation/test/schema surfaces; bind review and Evidence Map freshness to it while continuing to report ledger and branch heads separately.
